scope: A programmatically created six-kind form uses one empty body paragraph per typed block control. Static reference inspection does not establish live Word editing, cell/story creation or all #145 acceptance criteria.
schema: Open XML SDK 3.5.1 reported zero errors; validator DLL SHA-256 4126071233c70310683c0fa0b65648bbd34839afa7b0a2309fba13c22501ddec.

reference.producer: LibreOffice 24.2.7.2 420(Build:2), Ubuntu 24.04, writer_pdf_Export; image sha256:a3aaef646226d406fc2b511462beb0359f4cd8859d775f404bd8f137dfd5f644; repository Noto Sans fonts mounted read-only.
reference.result: The checker found six direct body wrappers, distinct IDs, the six expected control types and their one-paragraph content. Reference text retained Ada, X, Beta, Manual, 2026-10-31 and Approved in order. The working-tree assembly reproduced the DOCX byte for byte after the empty-style and aggregate control-limit checks were strengthened.

earlierAttempts: The first focused test compile failed CA1861 for test arrays and was corrected. The first block editing test used the inline rich-text replacement API; the existing block API was then used. A binding write-back test initially selected only one of two controls sharing a target and correctly failed Binding.Conflict; it now retains that negative and synchronizes both owners.
limitations: Generated DOCX/PDF and extracted text are scratch artifacts. This is a working-tree observation; final exact-commit source, package and hosted qualification require separate checks.
